gen-fs-oswald-gf-finlandica: Tight, tall and sure of itself, Oswald packs its rows close. Finlandica follows with a single fixed pen width and open-mouthed e crossbars, so paragraphs of sans text feel contemporary and easy to follow.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gantari: Approachable from the first word, Oswald's compact rows give way to something lighter below. Gantari looks bent from wire, with wide c openings, so a longer stretch of its sans-serif text moves along without any strain.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gayathri: Oswald comes in confident and strong, its lines packed tightly together. And Gayathri, a plain sans with open-ended curves and a restrained thick-thin gap like letterpress slug, keeps a longer passage feeling approachable.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-google-sans: Smooth and modern, with no thick-thin shift between downstrokes and curves, the body text moves cleanly. Google Sans pulls its terminals well back, which keeps a longer passage feeling approachable beside Oswald's strong, tightly knit headings.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-google-sans-flex: Google Sans Flex reads as professional and modern, with every stroke end looking cut from one ribbon and each curve left open. Oswald's tight rows bring the muscle.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gothic-a1: Approachable, with a splayed c terminal giving Gothic A1 its quiet quirk. Oswald's confident, tightly knit rows sit above that plain sans and give the page a strong top and an easy bottom.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gotu: Compact and commanding up top, with Oswald's rows pressed tightly together. Gotu relaxes underneath with sturdy hairlines, open-mouthed e crossbars and a mild thick-and-thin rhythm, a sans that gives the heading room to be loud.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gowun-dodum: Gowun Dodum has a wide-mouthed lowercase a and a smooth, tube-like line, set in a neutral sans-serif. But Oswald's tightly knit confidence sits above it, so give the body text a comfortable size.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gruppo: Gruppo keeps its curve endings well apart from one another. Against Oswald's confident, tightly packed rows, that sans-serif lightness is the pair's sharpest difference, strong on top and clean below.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-gudea: Oswald earns its place when words are big and short, its strong rows packed tight. Gudea answers with curves as thick as a drawn thread and glass-clear gaps at the terminals, a plain sans with no thick-thin shift.
